feedback: Written before this candidate has raced; no outcome is claimed for it. Evidence from earlier iterations: iteration 2 (kp 4.0, kd 0.3, wheel_track 0.11, wheel_radius 0.035) gave steering_oscillation 0.27 to 0.28 and control_effort about 8 to 8.5, with oval progress 0.63 and 2 of 20 oval finishes. Iteration 3 (y=0.08, wheel_track 0.13, wheel_radius 0.04, kp 4.0, kd 0.4) lifted oval completions to 16 of 20 and s-bend completions to 7 of 20, with steering_oscillation about 0.30 to 0.31, control_effort about 10 on the s-bend, and all 20 slalom runs ending off_track at max_error about 0.064. So sensing and lookahead are working, and the remaining failure is turn response on alternating bends. Integration work: I kept the seven-sensor weights scaled to x/0.015, kept ki 0.15 for the motor mismatch, and lowered kp to 3.8 with kd 0.45 because the narrower track and lighter body speed up the heading response. Next race, the change depends on the result. If steering_oscillation rises above 0.31 on the s-bend or slalom, the yaw damping is too low for this agility gain, so return wheel_track toward 0.13 m. If slalom max_error stays at or above 0.06 while oscillation stays at or below 0.31, the body is not turning fast enough and the next lever is lower yaw inertia, not more track width. If oval completions fall below iteration 3's 16 of 20, the lighter body has cost stability or speed, so restore mass toward 0.6 kg.
requested_changes: If steering_oscillation rises above 0.31 on the s-bend or slalom in the next race: set wheel_track back to 0.13 m, since iteration 3 at 0.13 m kept oscillation at 0.30 to 0.31 and iteration 2 at 0.11 m overshot to 0.27 to 0.28.

If slalom max_error stays at or above 0.06 while steering_oscillation stays at or below 0.31: try mass 0.45 kg with body_length 0.12 m, lowering yaw inertia further, since iteration 3 slalom failed at max_error 0.064 with no completions.

If oval completions drop below iteration 3's 16 of 20 with the lighter body: return mass to 0.6 kg, since the 0.6 kg body in iteration 3 completed 16 oval runs and 7 s-bend runs with stable ground speed.
